30秒板上存活且位移与接触达标: 30-second skateboard survival with displacement and contact criteria met.
触球后过网且首次落点在对场界内: Return crosses the net and first lands inside the opposite court.
30秒速度指令序列及跟踪和停车检查: 30-second velocity-command sequence with tracking and stopping checks.
原生连续楼梯场景；此处展示单条实际录像。: Native continuous-stair scene; one actual recording is shown here.
真实目标抵达与驻留且物理有效: Physical target arrival and dwell, with valid physics.
实际接触抬箱并搬运: Physical box lift and carry with actual contact.
无原生失败的完整参考完成率: Full-reference completion rate without native failure.
教师种子9101/9102，学生10101/10102；一个直行命令和一个转向命: Teacher seeds 9101/9102; student seeds 10101/10102, with one straight and one turning command. Different seeds prevent episode-by-episode pairing.
从板上起步；无自主上板验收。128维context来自冻结的HUSKY本体感觉隐: Starts on the board; autonomous mounting was not evaluated. The 128-dimensional context comes from the frozen HUSKY proprioceptive hidden layer, not a visual encoder.
位移更大并不代表精确速度或转向跟踪更好。: Greater displacement does not imply more accurate velocity or turning tracking.
16个同种子40秒回合，各8个完整来球；128个球不是128个独立机器人回合。: 16 matched-seed, 40-second episodes with 8 complete incoming balls each. The 128 balls are not 128 independent robot episodes.
学生执行教师动作0步；使用球状态与原生观测，不是摄像头像素。: The student executes zero teacher-action steps. Inputs are ball state and native observations, not camera pixels.
原生ATHLETE G1物理与电机；尚非规范HoloMotion硬件配置的跨机器: Uses native ATHLETE G1 physics and motors; this is not cross-robot validation on the canonical HoloMotion hardware configuration.
老学生35k→所选44k的提升只能说明本流程改进，不能证明预训练基座相对随机基座: The improvement from the earlier 35k student to the selected 44k student reflects this training process; it does not establish a causal benefit of a pretrained over a random base.
回旋踢为参考动作PPO专家，没有被蒸馏的策略教师；不能把运动学参考当作物理教师。: The roundhouse expert uses PPO with a motion reference, without a distilled policy teacher. A kinematic reference is not a physical teacher.
31清单指向continuation_250/model_499；既有报告正式选: The 31-task roster points to continuation_250/model_499, whereas the existing report selects continuation_100/model_349. This comparison uses the reported selection and does not mix them.
本轮竞争路由踢腿model_840属于另一实验，不纳入旧连续融合31项师生表。: The model_840 kick with competitive routing belongs to a separate experiment and is excluded from the historical 31-task teacher-student table with continuous mixing.
教师8环境种子7002，学生16环境种子8101/8102；这是不同种子的分布对: The teacher uses 8 environments at seed 7002; the student uses 16 environments at seeds 8101/8102. This is a distributional comparison across different seeds.
完整序列存活与批次级跟踪、停车验收同时列出；未将批次验收当成独立逐环境跟踪成功。: Full-sequence survival and batch-level tracking/stopping acceptance are reported separately. Batch acceptance is not treated as independent per-environment tracking success.
输入本体状态与速度命令，无摄像头像素；导航展示另外使用仿真定位。: Inputs are proprioceptive state and velocity commands, without camera pixels. The navigation demonstration additionally uses simulation localization.
教师门禁6/8与学生16/16来自不同种子；精修前学生在同一16种子是13/16: The teacher gate result of 6/8 and student result of 16/16 use different seeds. Before refinement, the student scored 13/16 on the same 16 seeds. These are separate comparisons.
教师和学生种子不同；相同场景任务的分布描述不能宣称逐回合获胜。: Teacher and student use different seeds. A distributional comparison on the same task and scene does not establish episode-by-episode wins.
不同版本reset、目标生成及终止判定有所演进；只使用对应最终训练版本的教师，绝: Reset, goal generation and termination rules evolved between versions. Only the teacher corresponding to the final training version is used; earlier failed teachers are not substituted.
每项须核对目标驻留和物理有效性；time_out或参考完成本身不算通过。: Goal dwell and physical validity must be checked for each task. A timeout or completion of the reference alone does not count as success.
教师为本地适配至规范HoloMotion电机的PMT教师，并非未经修改的官方发布: The PMT teacher was locally adapted to the canonical HoloMotion motors; it is not the unmodified official checkpoint.
教师7002/7003，所选学生7602/7603；后者16/16优于早期学生1: Teacher seeds 7002/7003; selected student seeds 7602/7603. The selected student scores 16/16 versus 11/16 for an earlier student, not versus the teacher.
Actor和奖励均使用官方优化参考placement0；不代表Raw走路依靠视觉: Both the actor and reward use the official optimized placement0 reference. This does not show that raw walking visually adapts to arbitrary terrain.
教师视觉冻结，但学生context还含观测桥接信息；视觉必要性尚无消融。: The teacher visual component is frozen, but student context also contains observation-bridge information. The necessity of vision has not been ablated.
512环境初态相同且确定性；这是一个条件下的重复验证，不是512个独立试验。: The 512 environments have identical, deterministic initial states. These are repeated checks under one condition, not 512 independent trials.
物理搬运与参考播完分开评分；公共底座512/512存活并播完，却0/512发生物: Physical carrying and reference completion are scored separately. The public base survives and finishes the reference in 512/512 cases, but physically carries the box in 0/512.
学生未超越教师搬运率；抬升与平移高度、接触时间的差异不是统一质量排序。: The student does not exceed the teacher carrying rate. Differences in lift height, translation and contact time do not define a single quality ranking.
原生ULTRA机器人与执行器；不能当作规范HoloMotion电机配置上的迁移验: Uses the native ULTRA robot and actuators; this is not transfer validation on the canonical HoloMotion motor configuration.
同任务、种子7002和7003，各8环境；同一原生MuJoCo-Warp任务与参: The same native MuJoCo-Warp task and reference are evaluated at seeds 7002 and 7003 with 8 environments each. Without per-environment initial-state hashes, matching seeds do not prove elementwise identical initial states.
端点误差含失败回合；root误差按存活环境逐时平均，不是共同存活帧误差。: Endpoint error includes failed episodes. Root error is averaged over surviving environments at each time, rather than over jointly surviving frames.
完成参考不自动等同完成几何目标；数据仅覆盖固定发布任务。: Completing the reference does not automatically establish geometric-goal completion. Data cover only the fixed published tasks.
